title: Echo Guest Lecture 2027
objectives: Create networking opportunities with industry and alumni

claims.claim_text: We expect approximately 116 attendees for this Guest Lecture, in line with turnout at our previous Guest Lecture events.
We can deliver this Guest Lecture efficiently within INR 9,000, well below typical costs.
Our previous events were delivered on budget and received excellent participant feedback.
This event complies with all applicable university policies and approval requirements.
